domains.name: Localization Resource Engineering
domains.scope: Validate message parameter contracts, trace configured fallback and reconcile translation review lineage using bounded executable reference models.

skills.name: localized-message-placeholder-contract
skills.description: Check localized message parameters against their runtime roles when translated strings can lose, rename or misuse interpolation values.

skills.name: locale-fallback-resolution-trace
skills.description: Trace which locale resource actually supplies a message when fallback order, blank values or unavailable bundles can conceal missing translations.

skills.name: translation-source-revision-coverage
skills.description: Reconcile translated resources with current source keys and reviewed source revisions when renames or meaning changes can leave apparently complete catalogs stale.
